purpose: The ONLY regression net the selection tier gets against a running install. scripts/run_eval.py deliberately never calls the AI, so nothing else in the repo exercises mode answer / options / none end to end, and nothing else proves that a refusal still refuses once a model is in the loop.
how_to_run: Start the app, then: .venv/bin/python scripts/smoke_options.py --base http://127.0.0.1:8000

expectations.options: the answer offers a numbered choice — source ai_options or local_company_search, and the options array is non-empty
expectations.pick: the answer is one record chosen from the offer printed by the PREVIOUS query — source local_pick
expectations.answer: one record answers it outright — any of the single-record tiers
expectations.refuse: out of scope: source refuse, or HTTP 503, never a confident record
